newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia Yield Spreads-Tightens again vs U.S..
newsitem.headline: Australia Yield Spreads-Tightens again vs U.S..

text.p: The Australian bond market continued this week's strong narrowing trend against the U.S., albeit finishing above the day's spread lows.
The local futures market saw another rally in early trading in the face of weak U.S. Treasuries on the expectation that domestic inflation and wages data in the next couple of weeks will be benign.

The domestic market also got a firm date for the outcome of the long awaited verdict on the "living wage" claim for Tuesday, another piece of news that could spur on the current tightening trend, analysts said.

In contrast the U.S. remains dogged by concerns that the Federal Open Market Committee on May 20 will endorse a further tightening in the Fed funds rate after Wednesday's stronger than expected industrial production data.

Meanwhile, the Canadian market outperformed the bloc after the Canadian dollar held firm in the face of strong U.S. data, while New Zealand bonds continued to unwind the spread narrowing seen earlier this week following its weaker than expected quarterly CPI report.
